verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for docs.getunleash.io/llms.txt. The file contains an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section telling agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown, and the cited doc pages are indeed served as .md URLs. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus bundle.
